purpose: Observed audit symptoms mapped to tests; original external outages are not reproduced offline.

cases.symptom: Source 404/403 and rejected images left no deliverable card.
cases.required_behavior: Reject unusable assets before scheduling; independent supplier access and visual acceptance must be proven.

cases.symptom: Production budget reservation blocked a model call.
cases.required_behavior: Reserve bounded experiment spend before each call; keep unknown charges reserved.

cases.symptom: Reuters 401 and Pexels 403 preceded image rejection.
cases.required_behavior: Report missing access separately from model/content quality.

cases.symptom: Only 5 of 123 candidates reached READY_FOR_SNAP; three attempts did not yield a fresh complete story.
cases.required_behavior: Require six validated frames and six receipts; failed delivery must not regenerate content.

cases.symptom: Successful workflow run skipped production steps.
cases.required_behavior: Only stored receipts can establish delivery.

cases.symptom: A send may be accepted remotely before the client times out.
cases.required_behavior: Mark unknown; never automatically resend without reconciliation evidence.
